Ref. 124607 – Product Specialist Guidance & Automation (m/f/d)

NOTHING RUNS LIKE A DEERE!

At our Kaiserslautern site, our European Technology Center plays a key role within the global John Deere research network. Around 250 employees explore future trends and develop technologies for mobile agricultural and construction machinery, working closely with a wide range of research institutes. Together, we develop and deliver innovative products and services in the field of precision agriculture. #wearekaiserslautern

Our department Production System Marketing is looking for a

Product Specialist Guidance & Automation (m/f/d)

In this position, you will work with interdisciplinary teams in the R2 Production System team, regional Tactical Marketing and Global ISG development departments. Your working environment is characterized by Agriculture 4.0 (Smart Farming, Data-Driven Decision Making, Automation and Sustainability).

What You’ll Get:

- modern and flexible working (35h/week full-time), hybrid and mobile working, part-time options, shared-leadership and much more
- excellent benefits, such as employer-funded occupational pension / life cover / income protection benefits
- further benefits such as subsidized Company Bike, FamPlus and much more
- an attractive compensation package including variable pay program

The salary for this position (full-time) is based on the ERA group EG 9 of the collective agreement of the metal and electrical industry Rheinland-Pfalz and consists, in addition to the gross monthly salary of 4932€, of various special payments (holiday pay, T-Zug, Christmas pay, etc.). You can expect an annual salary of approx. 68000 EUR in this position.

Your Responsibilities:

- You are responsible for regional marketing within our enterprise customer acquisition process, helping farmers and contractors unlock the value of our guidance and automation technologies, including the suite of solutions on our G5 Display, which enable near hands-free guidance and almost automated fieldwork execution.
- Working closely with different John Deere teams, dealers and customers, you define and validate the positioning and value proposition for the mentioned products, tailored to the local production systems of the region (e.g. small grains, dairy and livestock). 
- You manage the respective marketing launch plans, enabling successful product adoption and sustainable utilization.
- Finally, in collaboration with our tactical marketing team, you will align planned marketing campaigns and support the planning and presentation of our solutions at international trade fairs.

What Skills You Need:

- Completed studies or university education in the field of agriculture 
- Profound knowledge of the cultivation methods for small grains, corn and common special crops - ideally you have acquired this through your own practical experience. 
- Solid understanding of practices of farmers, including the work preparation, its execution and documentation
- In-depth understanding of precision farming products and solutions as well as experience in the field of Agriculture 4.0 and digitization in the agricultural sector
- Knowledge of customer requirements, markets, and competitors in the agricultural industry, especially in the field of precision farming
- Driving license class B and T as well as willingness to travel up to 25%
- Fluency in German and English is required, other languages are an advantage
- Experience in sales and marketing activities in the practical field service is an advantage

This tariff position is based in Kaiserslautern and available for immediate start.

This position follows a hybrid working model and requires employees to work from the office at least 2 days per week.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer (f/m/d) - Life Science and Diagnostics (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)
jobs.description:
Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About the opportunity

In the position of an AI Engineer (f/m/d) you will work with our system and software teams to develop instrument control and data analysis software for laboratory devices helping our customers to get valuable insights from a biological sample. You use your expertise building real-world AI agent systems to work in an environment where AI agents support the development of medical-grade software. In this role you will set the blueprint for AI-enabled software engineering across QIAGEN, changing how our developers, testers, architects and DevOps engineers work every day.

Your tasks include

* Design and build multi-agent workflows that automate software development lifecycle processes, from planning and design through implementation, testing and documentation.
* Translate the knowledge of our teams, including architecture decisions, domain models and business rules, into reusable, machine-readable building blocks that AI agents can work with reliably.
* Build evaluation loops that measure the quality and correctness of AI-generated outputs against the standards of a regulated environment, and continuously improve them.
* Integrate AI agents with the tools our teams rely on every day, as well as to our instruments and software products using MCP servers, Git, CI/CD pipelines and REST APIs.
* Serve as lead AI engineer, guiding and mentoring junior engineers and colleagues across the development team in adopting agentic AI in their daily work.
* Collaborate with international development teams in Poland, Spain, and Denmark to strengthen and refine your technical capabilities and personal network.

 

Your profile

* A master's degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related discipline
* 3+ years of professional experience in software and product development, including the successful delivery of complex software solutions in agile environments
* Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language and working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines and containerization
* Experience building AI agents, agentic systems or LLM-based applications, including evaluating, testing and validating AI-generated outputs
* Hands-on experience building MCP servers or clients and integrating AI agents with other systems through APIs. Knowledge of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) that allow AI agents to monitor and operate hardware through a common interface is a plus.
* Regular use of AI-assisted development tools in your daily work, such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot
* Excellent communication skills in both English and German (C1 level)

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

What to Expect

The Bodyshop Technical Trainer position requires someone with exceptional ability to deliver learning solutions within their region. The Tesla Bodyshop Technical Trainer will take responsibility for ensuring our internal and external repair network is equipped to deliver the best ownership experience the world has ever seen for every Tesla owner. Key responsibilities include facilitating hands-on technical Onboarding and Continuous Bodyshop technical training, mentoring and supporting Bodyshop technicians, and partnering closely with local Bodyshop Managers and regional network managers to train for skill gaps and elevate the performance of their teams and regions.   This individual must be creative, proactive, organized, flexible, results-oriented, and have a passion for and understanding of electric vehicles. Must have outstanding communication, facilitation, and organizational skills while demonstrating a positive and professional demeanor.Please note that only 1 role/headscount is open, to be hired either in the UK or Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Facilitate Onboarding and Continuous instructor-led and virtual Bodyshop technical training on electric vehicles equipped with complex automotive and electromechanical systems to enable employees to perform their role safely and to Tesla’s standards
- Maintain expert knowledge of the most current product knowledge, systems, methods, techniques, and best practices of Bodyshop repair procedure and processes  
- Support the Content Development team with reviewing training material, as needed  
- Support local apprentice programs as needed, including delivering training, supporting apprentice mentors, and reviewing training materials
- Partner with Managers and Coaches to identify and train for skill gap development of employees
- Serve, coach and mentor a network of Internal Bodyshop technicians and coaches to enhance core capabilities and ensure continuous process improvement
- Support and manage any local and specific projects with minimal guidance

What You’ll Bring

- Fluency in English is a non-negotiable requirement. Dutch and German language skills would be a plus
- Strong understanding of vehicle body repair processes, including aluminum and steel welding, mechanical, electrical, trim and refinishing knowledge. Experience of electric vehicles repairs is strongly preferred
- Strong facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills required
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and demonstrated confidence and professionalism in working in a customer-facing role
- Proactive, flexible, confident, professional, and self-directed in a fast-paced environment
- Ability to travel at least 60% of the time, with a valid Driver’s License and a valid passport
- Experience with environmental and safety requirements is a plus

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Data & Analytics to identify opportunities for innovation

SCHOTT's openness to promote your further development is just as great as our additional benefits. Ranging from active health management via flexible working hours and hybrid work all the way to corporate pension plans: everything geared to suit your goals and needs. Discover a special corporate culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop their entire potential.
At SCHOTT, you can expect a unique corporate culture where we emphasize equity, diversity, and inclusion. We know: motivated and committed employees are the precondition for the success of our company.

Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. - Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Manager (f/md) for Supplier Relationship Management & Supply Chain Resilience, you will work closely with the management team of GS D Procurement and the Gas Services Project Orion. Your role is essential to drive objectives of the ORION project to de-risk the GS D supply chain. In this role you report to the Head of Commodity Management and will work closely with the head of GS D procurement and the CPOs of the product lines, as well as the project organization in Gas Services. The tasks range from monitoring, improvement and developing the supplier relationship management and risk-mitigation in the supply chain. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Establish, maintain, and actively manage supplier relationship management activities
* Analyze supply chain de-risking activities across GS D, benchmark and exchange with Orion project team members on Gas Services level, drive improvements and process harmonization
* Drive cost-saving initiatives and risk-mitigation actions together with commodity managers, project management, finance, engineering, and supply chain teams
* Increase data-driven decision making, leveraging integrated supply chain tools and support of AI
* Prepare transparent project progress tracking, identifying risks and taking mitigation action with SQ, Procurement, Engineering in GS D

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, combined with project management skills, and understanding of supply chain topics across the value chain from Sales, to Engineering and to Procurement. 
* Longstanding professional experience in managing complex projects, financial analysis, procurement, or a comparable environment, typically gained over 5+ years.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, strategic-thinking, influencing, and process-improvement skills across procurement, finance, project management, and supply chain interfaces.
* Proven ability to manage complex projects with cross-functional stakeholders and track record of realizing project targets on time & on budget.
* Fluent in English and German is an advantage 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.

- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
